requirements.text: The loop shape is: Claude Code performs one authorized unit of work, returns a structured checkpoint, the supervisor gathers live evidence, a compact digest-bound packet goes to a fresh read-only Codex process using the owner-chosen model, and Codex returns one structured decision.

requirements.text: AUTO tier outcome: the next safe prompt goes to Claude immediately.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: NOTIFY tier outcome: the action proceeds and the owner is told asynchronously.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: ASK tier outcome: the question is queued and the loop parks or works around it.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: HARD-DENY tier outcome: the action is blocked and logged, and the run continues or halts per policy.

requirements.text: Target steady state is limited-auto mode advancing through every non-owner-gated phase overnight - implementation, checkpoints, reviews, corrections, and PR creation and update - waking itself after usage-limit resets, rotating Claude sessions when needed, and recovering from crashes and reboots on its own.

requirements.text: Merge, acceptance, and the other owner gates are never completed autonomously: an overnight run ends at those gates, not past them, parking safely with its remaining questions queued.

requirements.text: The run stops synchronously only for the short list in Section 4.5.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The owner-touch budget per task is the start command, a small number of queued ASK decisions answered at the owner's convenience, and one milestone review at COMPLETE.

requirements.text: If shadow testing shows more synchronous stops than the configured budget, file that as a usability defect with a per-stop disposition.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The owner-touch budget measures usability and never becomes authority.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Any widening of AUTO or NOTIFY to meet the owner-touch budget requires a proposed deterministic policy change, security and control-plane review, replay testing, and explicit owner approval.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Neither a model nor an implementer may widen autonomy merely to satisfy the owner-touch metric.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The supervisor is a coordinator, evidence collector, and state machine; it is not a new source of project truth.

requirements.text: Claude Code works only within the authority already granted by the current controlled task.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Claude Code may inspect, implement, test, prepare evidence, and create task artifacts permitted by the task packet, using the repository's existing producer, reviewer, and orchestrator separation.

requirements.text: Claude Code returns a structured checkpoint after every bounded unit.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Claude gains no new authority merely because the supervisor sends its next prompt.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: For every review, launch a fresh Codex process - a new session per review - using the owner-configured model from Section 3.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Never maintain one endlessly growing Codex thread.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Phase 0 verifies behaviorally that --ephemeral leaves no session transcript on disk.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Pass the compact review packet through standard input.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Codex must remain read-only and never edit, stage, commit, push, merge, accept, or mutate project-control.

requirements.text: Codex must return exactly one schema-valid decision.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Codex must cite evidence paths, commands, SHAs, PRs, checks, and unresolved gaps.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Codex must refuse to manufacture proof when evidence is unavailable.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The supervisor launches and monitors bounded Claude runs, parses structured output, gathers authoritative evidence, launches fresh Codex reviews, and validates decisions.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The supervisor applies the Section 4 tier policy before forwarding anything.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The supervisor persists transactional crash and reboot recovery state, rotates Claude sessions safely, and queues or pauses when the owner is required.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The supervisor must not reason around a failed policy check.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The owner chooses the Codex models and the Claude models.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The two providers have fully separate immutable allowlists, separate runtime selections, and separate fallback chains.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The supervisor never chooses for the owner beyond a provider's own owner-approved chain and never satisfies one provider's requirement from the other provider's list.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Model selection is runtime configuration, deliberately separated from the immutable controller configuration so that changing a model never invalidates the controller manifest.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The immutable controller config file config.toml is covered by the controller manifest and holds policy rules, tier definitions, limits, security settings, and the per-provider allowlists of models the owner permits at all.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Changing config.toml follows the full controller-update process of Section 13.1.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The runtime model_selection.toml file sits outside the controller manifest but is digest-recorded and holds which allowlisted model is currently active per provider and role.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Changes to model_selection.toml occur only through the authenticated model-change path defined in Section 3.2 rule 6.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Changes to model_selection.toml occur only at a checkpoint boundary.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Changes to model_selection.toml are audit-logged with before and after selection digests.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: A model_selection.toml change can never alter the sandbox, permissions, tiers, or any other authority.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Codex allowed_models list in config.toml names every Codex model the owner permits in any role, and nothing outside that list may ever run as Codex.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Claude allowed_models list in config.toml names every Claude model the owner permits for the worker; an empty list means only the account or CLI default may be used and no explicit Claude selection is permitted.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Codex review_model is the primary model for checkpoint reviews and must be in the Codex allowed_models list.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Codex advisory_model is an optional cheaper model for low-stakes advisories only, and an empty value means use review_model.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Codex fallback_models entry is an ordered fallback chain whose every entry must be in the Codex allowed_models list; empty means no fallback and an ASK is queued instead.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Claude model entry is the worker model; empty means the account or CLI default, and if set it must be in the Claude allowed_models list.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The Claude fallback_models chain must have every entry in the Claude allowed_models list; empty means no fallback and an ASK is queued instead.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Each configuration file must parse as valid standalone TOML.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: A selection or fallback entry is validated against its own provider's allowlist only: a Codex entry can never satisfy the Claude list and a Claude entry can never satisfy the Codex list.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Do not introduce a reasoning-effort key or any other effort key in any configuration file, prompt, or CLI invocation.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Do not assume the effort-key prohibition applies only to Claude.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Supervisor-launched Codex invocations additionally pass --ignore-user-config so the owner's personal Codex configuration, including any personal effort setting, never reaches a supervisor-launched process, thereby narrowing the R159 scope question to project-controlled templates and invocations.

requirements.text: Rule 1: verify the exact model flag or config key, -m, --model, or profile equivalent, against codex exec --help on the installed CLI before use, and do not assume flag names from this document.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 2: the supervisor CLI accepts --codex-model to override review_model for a single run.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 2: the --codex-model override must name an entry in the Codex allowed_models list.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 2: the --codex-model override must pass the same authenticated model-change path as rule 6, because a local invocation is not automatically owner-authenticated.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 2: the --codex-model override is recorded in the audit log and in every decision record it affects.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 3: doctor and preflight must confirm each selected Codex and Claude model is in its own provider's allowed_models list and is accepted by the corresponding installed CLI and account.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 3: an unavailable model tries its own provider's fallback_models in order, and engaging a fallback is a NOTIFY event.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 3: if a fallback chain is exhausted, queue an ASK and hold, and never silently substitute a model.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 4: a model outside its own provider's allowed_models list must never be used in any role, even if the provider defaults to or suggests one, and even as a fallback.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 5: every Codex decision's audit record includes the model name, any provider-reported model or version identifier, and the digest of the model_selection.toml in force.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 6: runtime model changes, set-codex-model, set-claude-model, or the authenticated remote surface, are accepted only through a controller-owned IPC channel protected by operating-system access control, such as a named pipe or local socket whose ACL restricts it to the owner's account and the controller principal.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 6: every model change requires explicit interactive owner confirmation in which the controller displays the provider, the old and new model, and the resulting selection digest, proceeding only on an affirmative confirmation bound to that exact change.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 6: requests originating from the worker or reviewer process trees, or from any environment the worker can write to, are identified and denied, and the worker environment must not be able to reach the IPC endpoint at all.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 6: model changes take effect only at a checkpoint boundary and never reset task state.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 6: every model change produces a complete audit record with caller identity, channel, confirmation evidence, before and after model_selection.toml digests, and the affected run and task IDs.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 6: a model_selection.toml change arriving by any other path is refused and pauses per Section 4.5 as controller-adjacent tampering.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Rule 7: model changes never widen authority - the Section 4 tier policy, the sandbox, and all permissions apply identically regardless of which model is selected or which model produced a recommendation.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: advisory_model exists only to cut cost on low-stakes calls: routine advisory-eligible tool-approval recommendations with no security sensitivity, and non-binding triage or summarization that the deterministic policy already bounds.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: advisory_model must never be used for security-sensitive approvals or for any approval touching an external write.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: advisory_model must never be used for recovery reasoning about ambiguous effects or for scope or authority interpretation.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: advisory_model must never be used for final handoff verification before autonomous continuation.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: The restricted advisory cases use review_model, or its engaged approved fallback, or deterministic verification - never the cheaper model.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: Every proposed action, tool call, and candidate forwarded prompt is classified into exactly one tier by the deterministic local policy engine.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: A model recommendation, from Claude or from Codex, may move an action to a stricter tier, never to a looser one.
requirements.status_reason: captured from the v4.3 supervisor build directive; verified at D-007 verification

requirements.text: AUTO applies only when the action is fully within the current task packet's authority.

requirements.text: Task-branch pushes and PR creation or update are executed by the supervisor itself as deterministic controller actions after a passing review, never by the worker process, which holds no push credentials.

requirements.text: The task packet, or a tracked owner note attached to it, may pre-authorize named, exact-shape standing grants for that task only, such as an auto-approve entry for a specific test command or for a push to a specific task branch.

requirements.text: Standing grants are owner-created, task-scoped, argument-validated, and expire with the task.
